subject: general
question: The Amazon Rainforest which is well known as the lungs of the earth is located in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**South America**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As an ecosystem, Amazon is one of the most biodiverse places on earth. Over 3 million species live in the rainforest, and over 2,500 tree species help to create and sustain this vibrant ecosystem.
 
• The Amazon is found in South America, spanning Brazil, Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana.
 
• The major part of the "Amazon forest" is contained in Brazil (60%), Peru (13%), and Colombia (10%).
 
• The rest of the Amazon forest is found in Ecuador, Bolivia, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname, and French Guiana.
 
• The Amazon rainforest is the largest "Tropical Rainforest" and the largest "Biodiverse Field" in the world. 
 
• The Amazon Basin is roughly the size of the forty-eight contiguous United States and covers some** 40 per cent** of the South American continent.
